hint.text: Commas are used to separate fronted adverbial phrases from the rest of the sentence. There should be a comma placed after the fronted adverbial.

instruction.text: Rearrange the sentence so that the adverbial phrase is at the start.

atoms.a: I wash the dishes after dinner.
There are lots of books in the library.
There are lots of different types of animals in the rain forest.
The sunset can be seen in the distance.
I volunteer for the local dog shelter once a week.

instruction.text: Read the text and drag the comma to the correct place.

atoms.a: As soon as I get home, I start cooking my dinner.
atoms.b: As soon as I get home((,)) I start cooking my dinner.

atoms.a: Once a month, I wash my car with soap and water.
atoms.b: Once a month ((,)) I wash my car with soap and water.

atoms.a: In the morning, I will feed the rabbit.
atoms.b: In the morning((,)) I will feed the rabbit.

atoms.a: At the train station, there was a steam train.
atoms.b: At the train station((,)) there was a steam train.

atoms.a: At the airport, I worked on my essay.
atoms.b: At the airport((,)) I worked on my essay.
